Ganz T provided a comprehensive review of systemic iron homeostasis, detailing the regulatory mechanisms and physiological implications, in a 2013 article in Physiological Reviews. 4. Nutritional anemias remain a significant public health concern, and tools for effective prevention and control have been outlined in various guidelines, including those accessed on January 12, 2020. 5. Verdon F, Burnand B, Stubi CL, et al., conducted a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial to assess the efficacy of iron supplementation in non-anemic women experiencing unexplained fatigue, with findings published in BMJ in 2003. 6. Li R, Chen X, Yan H, et al., investigated the functional consequences of iron supplementation in iron-deficient female cotton mill workers in Beijing, China, with results published in The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition in 1994. 8.
